page.notes: The Greek words ἐκκεντρότης and ἐπικυκλος are read from a small, worn impression and are doubtful. The letter u in "lineola u" is uncertain. The inset diagram shows concentric circles: a and b at the centre, c on the left, d at the top, e on the right, and r, s, t, q on the small epicycle near the top; it is not transcribed as text. The text is cut off at the right edge of the scan and the lower part of the column is faint.
